newsitem.title: UK: Midland outlook brightened by newsprint price fall.
newsitem.headline: Midland outlook brightened by newsprint price fall.

text.p: Midland Independent News Plc said on Wednesday its prospects for 1997 had been boosted by a stronger portfolio of titles and a fall in newsprint prices.

"We do feel that going into 1997 we have a stronger portfolio of titles," said Midland finance director John Whitehouse in a telephone interview with Reuters. "Newsprint prices have settled 20 percent lower than last year," he added.
Midland pre-tax, pre-exceptional profit rose 4.7 percent to 16.6 million pounds in 1996, in spite of a 3.3 million pound rise in its newsprint bill.
